# If the Joomla site is installed within a folder
# eg www.example.com/joomla/ then the robots.txt file
# MUST be moved to the site root
# eg www.example.com/robots.txt
# AND the joomla folder name MUST be prefixed to all of the
# paths.
# eg the Disallow rule for the /administrator/ folder MUST
# be changed to read
# Disallow: /joomla/administrator/
#
# For more information about the robots.txt standard, see:
# http://www.robotstxt.org/orig.html
#
# For syntax checking, see:
# http://tool.motoricerca.info/robots-checker.phtml

# Reguly ogolne dla robotow.
# Crawl-delay dziala tylko dla robotow, ktore go obsluguja.

User-agent: *

# Blokada skanowania wariantow stron z parametrem kalendarza
Disallow: /*?iccaldate=
Disallow: /*?*&iccaldate=
#
Disallow: /administrator/
Disallow: /bin/
Disallow: /cache/
Disallow: /cli/
Disallow: /components/
Disallow: /includes/
Disallow: /installation/
Disallow: /language/
Disallow: /layouts/
Disallow: /libraries/
Disallow: /logs/
Disallow: /modules/
Disallow: /plugins/
Disallow: /tmp/
Disallow: /api/
Crawl-delay: 10

# Dostep do publicznych zasobow rozszerzen Joomla.

Allow: /modules/mod_djmegamenu/assets/
Allow: /modules/mod_djmegamenu/mobilethemes/
Allow: /modules/mod_djimageslider/assets/
Allow: /modules/mod_djimageslider/themes/
Allow: /modules/mod_news_pro_gk5/cache/
Allow: /modules/mod_news_pro_gk5/interface/
Allow: /modules/mod_iccalendar/js/
Allow: /components/com_icagenda/themes/packs/default/css/
Allow: /components/com_icagenda/themes/packs/default/images/
Allow: /plugins/system/ef4_jmframework/includes/assets/template/js/
Allow: /plugins/system/jce/css/

# Zakaz skanowania dla najbardziej aktywnych robotow.

User-agent: Baiduspider
Disallow: /

User-agent: meta-externalagent
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

# GoogleOther - oddzielny robot od Googlebota wyszukiwarki.

User-agent: GoogleOther
Disallow: /

# Zachowane dotychczasowe blokady.

User-agent: SeekportBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: BLEXBot
Disallow: /
